$comment: Machine-readable Sprint 5 plan. Prose rationale lives in specs/sprint-5-charter.md; this file is the shape delivery_loop_gate.py consumes. That script is NOT in this repo — it ships with the pm-skills plugin. Resolve it deterministically: mapfile -t G < <(find ~/.claude/plugins -path '*/pm-skills/scripts/delivery_loop_gate.py' | sort); [ ${#G[@]} -ge 1 ] || { echo 'FAIL: no delivery_loop_gate.py found'; exit 1; }; [ "$(printf "%s\n" "${G[@]}" | xargs sha256sum | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u | wc -l)" = 1 ] || { echo 'FAIL: installs differ -- pin one'; exit 1; }; python3 "${G[0]}" --plan specs/sprint-5-loop-plan.json --mode plan --output human. Acceptance commands live in scripts/sprint_5_gate.py, one subcommand per task; it reads the sprint, board and ticket keys from THIS file and holds none of its own. Sprint goal: board reconciliation + doc consolidation. Done when (A) board triaged, non-Done ≤ deliberate backlog and (B) validate_specs.py green with ≤19 governed docs. The limit was ≤14 until 2026-10-05; that was unreachable -- 28 governed docs, 9 of them tier-4 -- and the owner re-scoped to the 9 tier-4 removals. No code milestones — housekeeping sprint. WIP cap 3, 2 attempts/task, 6 iterations. Reviewer: claude-review.yml only (no /codex).
goal: Board reconciliation + doc consolidation. Done when: (A) board triaged, non-Done ≤ deliberate backlog; (B) validate_specs.py green with ≤19 governed docs. PLZG Sprint 5.

jira.source: docs/delivery-coordinates.md (D-026) owns these; this is the machine-readable copy the gate reads

tasks.title: Fetch and reconcile against origin/dev before any other task runs
tasks.note: Blocking precondition, exempt from the attempt cap. No Jira ticket: it is a precondition the SessionStart hook already runs.

tasks.title: Clear the 7 stale In Progress items (PLZG-129, -199, -209, -215, -221 Done; -200 fixed by PR #252; -180 Won't Do)
tasks.note: Originally 'transition 6 false-WIP items to Done' on the assumption that a merged PR carrying a ticket's key meant the ticket's work was done. Checked against dev on 2026-10-05, that held for four of the six. PLZG-180 and PLZG-200 had their keys reused by unrelated PRs (#178; #199/#203) and their defects were still in the code. Outcome: PLZG-129, -199, -209, -215, -221 verified and transitioned with evidence comments; PLZG-200 fixed by PR #252 and Done when that merges; PLZG-180 closed Won't Do by owner decision (Done plus the wont-do label, since the workflow has no Won't Do status). PLZG-142 had no work behind it and returned to To Do, where T2 triages it. Verify a ticket against the file, never against the PR title.

tasks.title: Three-bucket triage of To Do backlog (Done/Keep/Won't Do)
tasks.note: Review every To Do item individually. Bucket as done (already merged -- verify against the file), keep (real remaining work), or wont_do (stale or duplicate). Do not bulk-close. BEFORE moving anything, record the To Do column as baseline_keys with baseline_captured_at in specs/evidence/sprint-5-triage.json: coverage is measured against that baseline, because a closed item leaves the live column and could not otherwise be shown to have been skipped. Each row carries key, bucket, reviewed_at and reason. The gate then re-reads Jira: keep must still be open, done and wont_do must be Done, and wont_do must carry the wont-do label.

tasks.title: Ungovern the 9 tier-4 docs + mark Sprint 2/3 charters HISTORICAL (28→≤19)
tasks.note: Move the nine tier-4 documents (summaries, research, historical) from documents to exempt in doc-registry.json. Sprint 2 and 3 charters STAY governed and become status HISTORICAL: SPRINT-4-CHARTER derives_from SPRINT-3-CHARTER, and validate_specs.py rejects a derives_from that points outside documents. Before ungoverning any doc, grep for BOTH its D-nnn decisions and its doc_id in other documents' derives_from. Known case: AGILE-LIKE-IM-5 derives from AGILE-EXPLAINED -- both leave together. TASK-TRACKER, BRANCHING-STRATEGY and DEVOPS-SETUP were on an earlier removal list and are no longer in scope.

tasks.title: Cross-check surviving docs for state contradictions
tasks.note: After T3, read each surviving governed doc and verify every claim it makes about state against the system that OWNS that state: git for code and history, Jira for board state, GitHub for repository settings and checks, CI for what a job does. CLAUDE.md is not an owner -- agreeing with it only shows two documents match. Fix what is wrong, then record one row per doc in specs/evidence/sprint-5-doc-crosscheck.json: doc_id, contradiction (explicitly false), verified_against (the owners consulted, or ["none"] for a doc with no state claims) and reviewed_blob (git hash-object of the file as reviewed). The gate recomputes the blob, so editing a doc after its review invalidates its row.

tasks.title: Sprint 5 charter (specs/sprint-5-charter.md), loop plan, Jira sprint creation on PLZG board
tasks.note: Charter, loop plan, gate script and doc-registry.json update in one PR. The gate also asks Jira that the sprint exists on the board and holds every task ticket.

tasks.title: Sprint close — both gates green
tasks.note: Procedural close. Re-runs T1-T4 against their owners and requires triage review_complete. Both gates must pass: (A) board triaged, (B) validate_specs.py green with ≤19 docs. Update charter status to HISTORICAL. Run delivery_loop_gate.py --mode close.
